def make_grid(n, walls, marks):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for x in walls:
        g[x]=[8]*n
        for r in range(n): g[r][x]=8
    for r,c,v in marks: g[r][c]=v
    return g

def expected_from_cells(n,walls,cell_size,active):
    g=make_grid(n,walls,[])
    starts=[0]+[x+1 for x in walls]
    for (ri,ci),v in active.items():
        r0=starts[ri]; c0=starts[ci]
        for r in range(r0,r0+cell_size):
            for c in range(c0,c0+cell_size): g[r][c]=v
    return g
